items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, you know, I would have thought that he'd played more like Louie on this without hearing the record.

ctx.x: Better do a little more talking, Dick, so... Yeah, yeah. Well, tell me about this piano and everything. Well, this is Lord Glenn. I guess Billy Douglas comes back on this. It's Dean Taylor. Yeah. It's Billy Douglas back in. And you can hear the drum back as Albert Fastmore.
Now, you know, I would have thought that he'd played more like Louie on this without hearing the record. But he wasn't just... Who is this, Billy?

Yeah, he was no copyist. No, no, no. It's just an original style. A lot of guys say he copied after some unknown trumpet player that I didn't ever hear of. Yeah. Jabo Spitt, but Jabo never played that style of trumpet. This guy's original in everything he did, even including his arrangements.
